A positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue, sell-side supply, and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. Binance sent out 752.9 million dollars, Crypto.com sent out 43.0 million dollars, and Bybit sent out 24.9 million dollars, while Bitfinex took in 25.7 million dollars.
